lyrics: maanitha gunasheela dhayaala - maam paalaya vara baalagopaala
mukundha mama maanasa padha saraseeruha dala yugala
aadhi madhyaantha rahitha vaibhava anantha kalyaana guna mama rakshaka
thakita dhrumitha thaka thaka dhimi dheem thaka - thaka dhika thom thaka thom thaka dhirana
vanaja nayana radha mukha madhukara rasika rasika vara raasa vilaasa
thakita dhrumitha thaka thaka dhimi dheem thaka - thaka dhika thom thaka thom thaka dhirana
navarasa ghaithata shobhitha vallabha nava vrajayuvathee manollaasa
thaka dhika thom thaka thom thaka dhirana kanaka manimaya noopura charanaa
thaka dhika thom thaka thom thaka dhirana kamala bhavanutha shaashvatha charanaa
kalpitha kali kalushajvala mardhana kaalinga nartthana kathitha janaardhana
